title: Coda UI Measures Frameworks Not Project Scoped
description: Measures and Frameworks are not project scoped but general in coda. Make sure the UI reflects this and show all information about measures, framework, properties (levels, etc).
summary: Refactored coda UI to clearly distinguish general (non-project-scoped) measures and frameworks from project-specific targets. Renamed Targets to Frameworks in Dashboard and Config pages. Added general badges and not project-scoped labels. Extended Property/Level types to include measures (lower/higher) and instructions with full detail rendering. Added coda://frameworks and coda://framework/{id} MCP resources. Fixed pre-existing bug in _load_json_with_comments that stripped // from URLs by anchoring regex to line start. Added clause property display and rule data schema display.
